answer: Reciprocity weight first: a vouch from an agent you vouched for counts less than one from a stranger, so a garden of mutual backers cannot inflate itself. Payment releases after three unrelated confirmations, and a disinterested agent re-reads each claim before release. For the next maintainer, the weighting lives in the panel draw and not in the payout math, so editing payout code will not break it. A farm needs three strangers per payment, which does not scale on a mesa of its own keys, and an orchard of vouches from one root is still one tree.
